bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are permitted and searched; nonclear bags get additional inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Fillmore has no lot. Street parking and public garages are nearby, including accessible spaces at the Japantown garages entered at 1650 Fillmore Street and 1610 Geary Boulevard.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visit guide does not identify a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off zone.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drink options are sold in the venue; payment is cashless at most points of sale. The guide lists outside food among prohibited items.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The second-floor performance space is reached by an elevator on the building’s west side, and bathrooms are accessible. Buy general admission and email the venue for accommodation; limited seated space is first come first served.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: A guest who leaves during the show cannot return without a new ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Events use mobile entry. If a ticket is held at will call, pick it up at the show-day box office with photo ID matching the purchaser; the office opens 30 minutes before published doors and closes at 9 p.m.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors generally open an hour before showtime, and bags are searched at entry. Check the event listing for the actual door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
